set.question: Which expression identifies the source of reported information?

options: According to the official source, the incident happened during the night.
According to my opinion, the official source disappeared last night.
The incident will happen tomorrow during the afternoon at the station.

template.prompt: Write two sentences: one reporting what witnesses said (according to them) and one reporting what television reported.
template.answer: Según los testigos, el objeto apareció durante unos minutos. La televisión informó de que varias personas habían visto una luz extraña.

old: The basic reported-speech pattern is decir/afirmar/declarar + *que* + statement.
new: The basic reported-speech pattern is *decir* / *afirmar* / *declarar* + *que* + statement.

set.question: Which sentence uses basic reported speech?

template.prompt: Report what the witness stated: that she had seen a light from her window.
template.answer: La testigo afirmó que había visto una luz desde su ventana.

template.prompt: Report what the mayor declared: that he did not know all the details and that the investigators needed more information.
template.answer: El alcalde declaró que no conocía todos los detalles y que los investigadores necesitaban más información.

new: "Use the new words for reporting speech."

old: "I can use three new reporting terms."
new: "I can use the new words for reporting speech."

set.question: Which expression normally takes the subjunctive when expressing doubt?

template.prompt: State one fact (the news has caused a reaction) and one opinion (you do not think the source is completely reliable).
template.answer: Es evidente que la noticia ha provocado una reacción, pero no creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable.

template.prompt: Evaluate a source: say you think it offers useful information, but you do not think it is completely reliable.
template.answer: Creo que la fuente ofrece información útil, pero no creo que sea completamente fiable.

new: After seeing the video, more people told what they had seen.

set.question: Which connector introduces the first event?

template.prompt: Put three stages of a news story in order: testimonies first, then a recording, and finally a statement from the investigators.
template.answer: Primero aparecieron los testimonios, posteriormente surgió una grabación y finalmente los investigadores publicaron un comunicado.

template.prompt: Say that witnesses first reported what happened, later a video appeared, and finally the investigators explained what had happened.
template.answer: Primero los testigos informaron de lo ocurrido, posteriormente apareció un vídeo y finalmente los investigadores explicaron qué había sucedido.

new: "Use the new words for sequencing a story."

old: "I can use three new sequencing terms."

set.question: What is the main purpose of a summary?
Which expression clearly introduces a summary?

options: In summary, the news report is about a phenomenon that still has no clear explanation.
In summary, the source has confirmed every possible explanation of the phenomenon.
The news report gives only a personal reaction, with no facts at all.
The most important thing is that the source has confirmed the main facts.
The source has denied all the facts and refused to talk to journalists.
The main point is that the journalist stopped reporting after the first day.

template.prompt: Summarise a news story in two sentences: it is about a strange phenomenon, and the most important thing is that independent evidence is still lacking.
template.answer: En resumen, la noticia trata de un fenómeno extraño. Lo más importante es que todavía faltan pruebas independientes.

template.prompt: Give a summary (several witnesses reported a strange light, but there is no definitive explanation) and a measured personal reaction (caution).
template.answer: En resumen, varios testigos informaron de una luz extraña, pero todavía no hay una explicación definitiva. Mi reacción es de cautela.

template.prompt: Report the main information (several people observed a phenomenon), then say you think more information is needed before deciding whether the explanation is reliable.
template.answer: La noticia informa de un fenómeno observado por varias personas. Creo que necesitamos más información antes de decidir si la explicación es fiable.

template.prompt: Say in summary that the story is still open and the investigators keep working, and that your reaction is prudent because independent evidence is still lacking.
template.answer: En resumen, la historia sigue abierta y los investigadores continúan trabajando. Mi reacción es prudente porque todavía faltan pruebas independientes.

old: "Use three new summary and response terms."
new: "Use new words to summarise and respond to the news."

new: "I can use new words to summarise and respond to the news."

Which sentence combines summary with evaluation?

template.prompt: Report information from the witnesses (a light appeared; later a video came out) and give a cautious evaluation: you do not think the information is completely reliable yet.
template.answer: Según los testigos, apareció una luz; posteriormente surgió un vídeo. No creo que la información sea completamente fiable todavía.

template.prompt: Write a short summary (several people reported a strange phenomenon and later new evidence appeared) and respond with caution because independent data is still lacking.
template.answer: En resumen, varias personas informaron de un fenómeno extraño y posteriormente aparecieron nuevas pruebas. Mi reacción es de cautela porque todavía faltan datos independientes.
